news.body:
## The money now waits on the visa
- INSEAD will not write the letter SBI asked for, and has offered to extend your deadline until the visa outcome instead.
Marie Rose asked where you are in the visa process, and that answer is the extension. Until she names a new date the instalment keeps reading yesterday on the board, which is honest rather than wrong. - Her question is the only thing between you and the extra time.
## The 10th is a visa date now, not just the loan's
- Delhi wants the loan sanction letter as proof of funds, and your counselling session falls on the same day the sanction is due.
So the 10th is the hinge: sanction, counselling, then the VFS booking, which waits on an automated Etudes en France mail rather than on you. - Nothing to chase before Monday, so the useful work is having the expense statement and the accommodation booking ready for it.
## Last working day before Sunday
- Both Google applications and your KITAS all end on the 8th, and the 8th is a Sunday.
None of the three can move tomorrow. You confirmed the Delhi slot yesterday, which was the right thing to clear first. - An hour each on the applications, and one call to Chitra.
